sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; PACE ranked first after duplicate screening.
The full arXiv PDF was read and expanded into a standalone Chinese Markdown analysis over 5000 Han characters.
The article explains the Local and Global selection signals, bootstrap regression, LOOCV protocol, ablations, and limitations.
The write-up separates predictive explanation from causal explanation and calls out calibration, gaming, and scaffold-transfer limits.
The paper was situated against benchmark compression, target sampling, static source benchmarks, and Agent safety monitoring needs.
The Markdown uses TL;DR, tables, formulas, pseudocode-style blocks, and Mermaid; no external image URLs are embedded.
